evidence.description: Requires independently licensed dependencies to retain their exact licenses and notices and requires distributed package contents to be audited.
Requires package metadata, notices, documentation, and distribution artifacts to preserve the boundary between CPAL Original Code and independently licensed material.

verificationCommands.description: Verifies both preserved official Unicode artifacts by checksum, re-derives normalization data from UnicodeData, runs the official normalization suite against the generated tables, regenerates the expected TypeScript in memory, and fails if the derived JSON, generated TypeScript, package metadata, or pinned npm inputs differ.
Runs every official Unicode 15.1 NFC conformance case through the compiled public schema-package normalizer so a generated runtime template regression cannot pass on generator-side agreement alone.

treatment.summary: The generated table incorporates Unicode 15.1 common and full case-fold mappings from @unicode/unicode-15.1.0 under MIT and canonical normalization data derived from official UnicodeData.txt under Unicode License V3. The exact UnicodeData and NormalizationTest files, both license texts, the derived JSON, source hashes, versions, conformance proof, and regeneration recipe are preserved. The generator and runtime algorithms are GENII Publisher Original Code under CPAL and are separately covered by the fresh implementation record.

scans.scope: Draft scan scope covers the exact Unicode source refs, both official Unicode artifacts, installed npm inputs, declared destination files, deterministic regeneration and conformance output, and packed schema package. Final outcomes require a stable destination manifest and byte-bound receipt.

exactBlob.method: Compare SHA-256 content identities for exact upstream license or data files and selected destination files.
exactBlob.evidence: Pending verification of both official Unicode artifacts and the stable destination receipt.

normalizedLine.method: Compare whitespace-normalized UTF-8 lines containing at least 60 characters across the exact upstream evidence and selected destination files.
normalizedLine.evidence: Pending final deterministic scan results bound to the stable destination manifest.

tokenShingle.method: Compare significant contiguous 16-token code windows after removing comments and literal bodies, normalizing numbers, and requiring at least six distinct nonnumeric identifiers.
tokenShingle.evidence: Pending final deterministic scan results bound to the stable destination manifest.

ccPhrase.method: No CC source paths are part of this preserved-material record.
ccPhrase.evidence: Expected final outcome is not-applicable after receipt generation.

packageLeak.method: Build the schema package through its full lifecycle in an owned clean workspace with the exact pinned npm CLI, hash the retained candidate archive, retain its file inventory, and reject declared Coherence names, paths, URLs, generated output, and durable publication state. An accepted candidate is the exact tarball supplied to publication.
packageLeak.evidence: Pending the final schema package archive digest and receipt.

review.notes: This draft records the intended third-party-preserved boundary. It requires offline verification of both official Unicode artifacts, exact installed npm inputs, deterministic regeneration, full normalization conformance, package inspection, maintainer review, human release approval, and counsel review before the first 1.0 release.
